text:
Maya: Heads up — planning thread for Hosted API GPU capacity for Q3/Q4. We need a recommendation on buys vs leases given expected seasonal traffic and current lead times.
Samir: Can you paste the demand projection numbers so we can calc GPU-hours?
Maya: Quick snapshot: baseline steady-state tokens = 120B/mo, projected peak (holiday and enterprise onboardings) +55% for 6 weeks. Model mix shift: 30% -> 40% large models (8k->32k context) by Oct. Estimated GPU-hours: baseline 48k GPU-hours/mo, peak 75k GPU-hours/mo.
Julia: Oof. Remind me unit economics: what’s our current fully burdened cost per GPU-hour for Dedicated vs spot + burst?
Samir: Rough: reserved/Dedicated ~ $2.10/GPU-hour (amortized incl infra + ops), burst (cloud + spot) effective $3.45/GPU-hour. Lease vendors quoting $1.85–2.00 if 12mo. Procurement capex changes this.
Aakash: Procurement note — OEM lead time is 10–14 weeks for new A100-equivalent boards, custom racks + networking adds ~4 weeks. Leasing partners can spin nodes in 4 weeks but limited region capacity in eu-west-1.
Lorenzo: From SRE side: our cluster has ~15% headroom right now. If we add expected model mix, autoscaling will push some jobs to warm pools and increase eviction risk on spot in us-west-2. Need extra hot capacity for low-latency customers.
ops-bot: [cluster health snapshot] live_nodes=482, avg_gpu_util=68%, 95p_latency_ms=42, eviction_rate_24h=0.9%
Maya: Key constraints: 1) budget targets — keep blended cost <= $2.50/GPU-hour, 2) latency SLOs for PLG tier must stay <50ms token, 3) lead time for buys.
Samir: Tradeoff analysis idea: Mix strategy — commit to 40% of incremental baseline growth via reserved buys (capex) to lock unit cost, lease 40% for elasticity, and keep 20% cloud burst for sudden peaks. That meets headroom and mitigates lead time.
Julia: That sounds reasonable. Finance can approve a $1.2M capex window if we can show 12 month payback vs full cloud. Need exact NPV calc.
Aakash: I'll reach out to two lease vendors (NodeFlex + FleetLease) for firm 30/60/90-day spin-up quotes and ESNet for rack+switch lead times.
Lorenzo: Operational ask: if we buy, we should reserve a dedicated pool for low-latency PLG traffic and set policy to route long-context large-model workloads to dedicated capacity to avoid noisy neighbor interference.
Maya: Can someone run quick scenarios: scenario A (buy 120 cards), B (lease equivalent), C (hybrid 60/60) with costs, lead times, and risk notes? Aim for a one-page slide by EOD tomorrow.
Samir: I'll produce GPU-hour sims and utilization curves. Using current telemetry, I’ll simulate month-by-month for next 9 months including holiday spike.
Julia: I'll do NPV and cashflow impact for each scenario.
Aakash: I'll fetch vendor timelines + preliminary contracts.
Lorenzo: I'll add operational checklist (onboarding, monitoring, canary traffic split, fallback routing).
Maya: Thanks — and please tag me when you add comments. Also flag any region blockers: eu-west-1 capacity is scarce for leases per Aakash. If enterprise demand skews EU, we might need to prioritize buys in that region.
Samir: Noted. I'll include region-level heatmaps and expected cross-region routing cost delta.
Maya: Cool. If anyone sees immediate red flags (budget or procurement), call now. Otherwise, sync tomorrow 11:00 for a decision-ready review. :thumbsup:
Julia: Added calendar invite.
ops-bot: Reminder: submit capacity request ticket with required node spec and target region by COB today to avoid procurement delay.
